# MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW  

---

### Put all models in the models folder, organized into their respective subfolders. 
### If a required folder doesn’t exist, create it.

---

## 🟣 Mel-Band RoFormer Model Loader
Download **MelBandRoformer_fp16.safetensors** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MelBandRoFormer_comfy/resolve/main/MelBandRoformer_fp16.safetensors)  

📁 **Place in:** `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/melband`  

---

## 🟣 Load Checkpoint & LTXV Audio VAE Loader
Download **ltx-2-19b-dev-fp8.safetensors** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2/resolve/main/ltx-2-19b-dev-fp8.safetensors)  

📁 **Place in:** `ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/ltx2`  

---  

## 🟣 Load CLIP  
Download **gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/GitMylo/LTX-2-comfy_gemma_fp8_e4m3fn/resolve/main/gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors)  

📁 **Place in:** `ComfyUI/models/text_encoders`  

---  

## 🟣 Load Latent Upscale Model 
Download **ltx-2-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2/resolve/main/ltx-2-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors)  

📁 **Place in:** `ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models`  

---

## 🟣 Load LoRA
 
Download **ltx-2-19b-lora-camera-control-static** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2-19b-LoRA-Camera-Control-Static/resolve/main/ltx-2-19b-lora-camera-control-static.safetensors)  


Download **ltx-2-19b-ic-lora-detailer.safetensors** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2-19b-IC-LoRA-Detailer/resolve/main/ltx-2-19b-ic-lora-detailer.safetensors) 

Download **ltx-2-19b-distilled-lora-384.safetensors** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2/resolve/main/ltx-2-19b-distilled-lora-384.safetensors)  
 

📁 **Place in:** `ComfyUI/models/loras/ltx2`  

---
